about: An annotator, signed in: Drive lets them add to the Extractions folder alone, so they may save, and not open Study Setup.

goals: Open one of the lab's microscope images from its shared Drive and get the site to count what it counts in it.
Check the count yourself, correct it where you think it is wrong, and hand your corrected version in to the lab.
